<div class="card-body">
'''Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４：マサッシ式典の間</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">位置カードを出すとき、このカードを一番最初にだせばライトサイドが先攻。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを占領していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-138o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room.

'''Light Side:''' When playing locations, if this is the very first location played, the Light Side goes first.

'''Dark Side:''' If you occupy here, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Light is the first location played (English: your starting location); Japanese Dark uses occupy (English: control).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
